
# WinUI Calc

> Official website of WinUI Calc. 

## Introduction

WinUI Calc is a 20KB only Android calculator that faithfully brings the modern Windows 11 Calculator (based on WinUI3) experience to your Android devices.

Download at: https://github.com/techambient/WinUICalc/releases/latest

Source code at: https://github.com/techambient/WinUICalc/

This website provides information about features, download URL, source code, and license documentation.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://techambient.github.io/WinUICalc)
- [Download](https://github.com/techambient/WinUICalc/releases/latest)
